name: Auric orbit / mineral light
art: The original effect is code-native. Read its geometry and physical material construction. No Orbkit/XorDev shader source was copied; preserve that distinction and check source licenses before substituting a third-party shader.

properties.label: Monumental mineral with spare copy
properties.text: Let one oversized irregular mineral orb dominate a blue-black stage, balanced by a wide spare editorial statement at left, quiet negative space and material controls at the lower edge. Wrap two very fine orbital arcs and tiny scattered specks around the silhouette.

properties.label: Irregular relief-cut mineral orb
properties.text: Use a large irregular orb with actual displaced geometric relief, fine ridges and occluded valleys rather than a smooth sphere.

properties.label: Neutral sans with humane serif emphasis
properties.text: Set the large statement in a neutral sans with warm text and humane serif emphasis, keeping the type spare enough to preserve the mineral orb's hierarchy.

properties.label: Charcoal mineral with gold veins
properties.text: Build a charcoal mineral body with muted metallic inclusions, narrow warm-gold veins and tiny granular detail. Give veins and stone different roughness and metallic response; do not replace them with uniform emission or a smooth gradient.

properties.label: Raking studio light over relief
properties.text: Use coherent studio light that catches ridges, leaves valleys dark and lets the inner veins read as light beneath matter.

properties.label: Stateful rotating mineral surface
properties.text: Mineral, Awakened and Glacial are three actual material/light states. Inner light changes vein glow; slow rotation and fine-pointer movement reveal the relief. Pause and reduced motion retain a composed object.

properties.label: Original displaced renderer
properties.text: The showcase uses a displaced Three.js mesh and original procedural material code. These implementation facts do not establish or license the external source's shader equations.

properties.label: Mineral relief inspection
properties.text: Inspect the full silhouette, vein thickness, ridge highlights, dark valleys and transition between all three materials. Every state must remain recognizable at phone size.

properties.label: Auric renderer lifecycle
properties.text: Verify hidden-tab stop, disposal, matching posters and actual CPU/GPU workload.
